multiline_round_trip.reader_difference: The 80-line explanation opens as five PDFium pages and four PDF.js pages. Short replacement opens as three in both. PDF.js verifies all controls; native readback verifies exact explanation text. Layout equivalence is not established.
multiline_round_trip.native_interaction: Direct split-field focus after rendering all five opening pages triggers four-page live layout and retains the full edit buffer. Cached page views are revalidated; native page changes update the app model and restore keyboard focus. Replacing the explanation and leaving the field contracts the live layout to three pages. Rendering and readback use the same worker.
